meta.name: PBS Food
meta.description:
PBS Food invites you into the kitchen with some of the best chefs, including Julia Child, Jacques Pepin, Marcus Samuelsson, and many others! These inspiring classic cooking shows are available 24/7 on PBS Food.

Shows: Chef Secrets: The Science of Cooking, A Chef's Life: The Final Harvest, Jacques Pépin's 80th Birthday Celebration, A Chef's Life Holiday Special, A Chef's Life
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
